description: Source file implementing SMS management functionality for an Android app, including sending and querying SMS/MMS messages with permission handling, contact lookup, and message parsing.

classes.name: SmsManager
classes.description: Manages SMS and MMS sending, querying, and permission handling within an Android context.

methods.name: hasSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has SEND_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadSmsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_SMS permission.

methods.name: hasReadContactsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has READ_CONTACTS permission.

methods.name: canSendSms
methods.description: Verifies if the device supports telephony and has SMS permission.

methods.name: canSearchSms
methods.description: Verifies if the app can read SMS with the appropriate permission.

methods.name: canReadSms
methods.description: Checks if the app can read SMS messages.

methods.name: hasTelephonyFeature
methods.description: Determines if the device has telephony hardware feature.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Attaches a PermissionRequester instance for runtime permission handling.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Suspend function to send an SMS message, with permission checks and error handling.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Suspend function to query SMS messages based on parameters, with permission and contact lookup handling.

methods.name: getPhoneNumbersFromContactName
methods.description: Retrieves phone numbers from contacts matching a contact name.

methods.name: querySmsMessages
methods.description: Queries SMS messages based on supplied search parameters.

methods.name: querySmsMmsMessagesByPhone
methods.description: Retrieves SMS/MMS messages associated with a specific phone number.

methods.name: getMmsTextBody
methods.description: Fetches the text body of an MMS message by message ID.

methods.name: getMmsMeta
methods.description: Retrieves MMS message box type and read status.

methods.name: getMmsAddress
methods.description: Gets the address associated with an MMS message.
